svg.title: Index Translator browser components, requests
svg.desc: The page's main module builds the request body, from text or an image and with the glossary, and picks the model by the text's length. A run sends it and reads the event stream through the resume module, which reconnects after the last event seen when the connection is cut. A web page is fetched through the same run before its Markdown is translated. a request: public/app.ts → public/run.ts → public/resume.ts → public/sse.ts. choose the model: public/app.ts → public/request.ts → public/select-model.ts.

g.text: wires the page, sends the request
builds the body, text or image
